mapper.select: SELECT id, request_no, company_id, vessel_id, port_id, work_type, work_description, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, worker_count, status, submitted_by, submitted_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, improvement_request_reason, safety_manager_name, safety_manager_tel, safety_manager_email, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_access_request WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT ar.id, ar.request_no, ar.company_id, c.name AS company_name, ar.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, ar.port_id, ar.work_type, ar.work_description, ar.planned_start_date, ar.planned_end_date, ar.worker_count, ar.status, ar.submitted_by, ar.submitted_at, ar.reviewed_by, ar.reviewed_at, ar.improvement_request_reason, ar.safety_manager_name, ar.safety_manager_tel, ar.safety_manager_email, ic.name AS industry_name, ar.created_at, ar.updated_at FROM tb_access_request ar LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ar.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = ar.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1 WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.deleted = 0

SELECT ar.id, ar.request_no, ar.company_id, c.name AS company_name, ar.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, p.name AS port_name, ic.name AS industry_name, ar.work_type, ar.planned_start_date, ar.planned_end_date, ar.worker_count, ar.status, ar.submitted_at, ar.created_at FROM tb_access_request ar LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ar.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = ar.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_port p ON p.id = ar.port_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1
ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_access_request ar LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ar.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = ar.vessel_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_access_request ( request_no, company_id, vessel_id, port_id, work_type, work_description, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, worker_count, status, submitted_by, submitted_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, improvement_request_reason, safety_manager_name, safety_manager_tel, safety_manager_email, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{requestNo}, #{companyId}, #{vesselId}, #{portId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{workType}, #{workDescription}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate},
#{workerCount} 0 ,
#{status} 'DRAFT' , #{submittedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{submittedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{reviewedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{reviewedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{improvementRequestReason,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{safetyManagerName,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{safetyManagerTel,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{safetyManagerEmail,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_access_request SET vessel_id = #{vesselId}, port_id = #{portId}, work_type = #{workType}, work_description = #{workDescription}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate}, safety_manager_name = #{safetyManagerName,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, safety_manager_tel = #{safetyManagerTel,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, safety_manager_email = #{safetyManagerEmail,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_access_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_access_request SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_access_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE tb_access_request SET status = 'IMPROVEMENT_REQUESTED', improvement_request_reason = #{reason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_access_request SET worker_count = #{count}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_access_request SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(request_no, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM tb_access_request WHERE request_no LIKE CONCAT('AR-', #{dateYmd}, '-%')
